statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations and episodes of syncope
Clinical evaluation suggests paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) as a potential etiology
Clinical evaluation suggests supraventricular tachycardia as a potential etiology
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) was ordered
The service is to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management
Diagnosis codes I48.0, I47.1, and R55 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
